description: Eliminate render-blocking CSS by implementing critical CSS inline extraction and deferring non-critical stylesheets. This addresses the 410ms render-blocking issue identified in Lighthouse (bundle.min.css 50KB/1350ms, modern-design-system.css 14.8KB/750ms, Bootstrap 33.5KB/1360ms).
steps: 1. Install django-compressor via pip and add to requirements.txt: Run 'pip install django-compressor' and append 'django-compressor==4.5.1' to requirements.txt

2. Configure django-compressor in projectshub/settings.py: Add 'compressor' to INSTALLED_APPS (after 'django.contrib.staticfiles'), add 'compressor.finders.CompressorFinder' to STATICFILES_FINDERS, set COMPRESS_ENABLED=True, COMPRESS_OFFLINE=True, COMPRESS_CSS_FILTERS=['compressor.filters.css_default.CssAbsoluteFilter', 'compressor.filters.cssmin.rCSSMinFilter'], COMPRESS_JS_FILTERS=['compressor.filters.jsmin.rJSMinFilter']

3. Extract critical above-the-fold CSS from bundle.min.css and modern-design-system.css (first ~200 lines covering navbar, hero, typography basics) into new file static/css/critical.css. Critical CSS should include: CSS variables/root, reset/box-sizing, html/body base styles, navbar styles, hero section, basic typography, layout utilities.

4. Modify templates/core/base.html: Move Bootstrap CDN link to bottom before </body> with media=print onload trick. Wrap bundle.min.css and modern-design-system.css links with {% compress css %} tags. Add inline <style> block in <head> containing critical.css content (read file and inline it).
5. Apply media=print onload deferred loading to bundle.min.css and modern-design-system.css in base.html using the same pattern already used for live-chat.css and idea-modal.css
6. Test on index, projects, workshop pages to ensure no FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content) or visual regression
acceptance_criteria: django-compressor installed and configured in settings.py
Critical CSS extracted and inlined in base.html <head>
bundle.min.css and modern-design-system.css deferred with media=print onload
Lighthouse 'Eliminate render-blocking resources' audit shows improvement
verification: Start server with 'python manage.py runserver', visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/ and visually confirm navbar, hero render immediately without FOUC
Check browser DevTools Network tab: bundle.min.css and modern-design-system.css should not block rendering
Run Django test suite: 'python manage.py test' - all 55 tests pass
findings: ✅ COMPLETED - Django-compressor 4.6.0 installed with rcssmin 1.3.0 and rjsmin 1.3.0. Configuration added to settings.py with INSTALLED_APPS, STATICFILES_FINDERS, and compression filters. Critical CSS extracted (minified) and inlined directly in base.html <head>. All non-critical CSS (bundle.min.css, modern-design-system.css, Bootstrap CDN) deferred with media=print onload pattern. Django system check passes with no issues. Collectstatic completed successfully with 3 new files, 259 unmodified. Ready for FEAT-002 (CSS bloat reduction).
